payload.reason: The evidence indicates that while some systems utilize statistical NLP models, many industrial dialogue systems still rely on handcrafted rules rather than off-the-shelf NLP systems.

claims.text: Many industrially deployed dialogue systems still use manual features or handcrafted rules instead of off-the-shelf NLP systems.
End-to-end approaches are not yet suitable for commercial conversational agents operating on real-world data, indicating reliance on traditional methods.
Hybrid models are replacing established rule- and template-based approaches, suggesting a shift away from off-the-shelf systems.
